{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas and handling errors
# First, confirm the format of the QA orders
qa_orders_comma = data[data['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = '999,999.99'): {len(qa_orders_comma)}")

# Check if any other QA-like values exist
# Look for any revenue values that are exactly '999,999.99' or '999999.99'
qa_orders_any = data[data['revenue'].str.contains('999,999.99|999999.99', na=False)]
print(f"Number of QA orders (any format): {len(qa_orders_any)}")

# Show the actual values of any such rows
print("\nActual values of suspected QA orders:")
print(qa_orders_any[['revenue', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status']])

# Now convert revenue to float, removing commas
# Replace commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify that the QA orders are now removed
qa_orders_clean = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders after cleaning (revenue_clean = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders_clean)}")

# Also check for refunded orders
refunded_clean = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_clean)}")"}
